summary: An editable PowerPoint deck for defending a kurs ishi, a bitiruv malakaviy ishi, a master’s dissertation or an internship report before a commission. Nothing on a slide is the AI’s own finding: every result, number, method, novelty, proposal and implementation restates the customer’s message or attached work, and only the framing slides (relevance, aim and tasks, object and subject) may be drafted from the topic’s own words, marked as a draft in the notes. The deck has the count asked (a slot with no material is an honest form), a formal title slide with the topic in full, one finding per result slide, conclusions that answer the tasks, and a closing slide that repeats the author.
tone: Formal, neutral and short on the slide: noun phrases and infinitive tasks of at most 10 words, 2 to 5 lines, never a paragraph and never “we”. Speaker notes are a speaking outline to the commission, first person singular, polite. Nothing on a slide is the AI’s own finding.
title: model

length.note: The count is delivered as quoted. The research rule "fewer slides when the material is thin" is replaced by honest blank forms on customer-source slots.

parts.write: Heading = the topic in full, never cut (up to 25 words or 260 characters; longer: the customer is asked to shorten, nothing is cut). Body = at most 6 lines, copied as written, in this order: work type (only in the customer’s words), institution and faculty, the author line, the supervisor line, the speciality, place and year. More than 6 lines: the ministry line goes first, then place and year, then the work type, and the customer is told which. Never completed, never reordered inside a line, never invented. No decorative disc, no notes, no photo.

A lead line naming the place as the customer gave it, then 2 or 3 lines (period, departments with their lengths) from the customer’s facts only; a hospital, department or supervisor not named is never named.

From the attached kirish or the message: 1 to 4 lines of at most 10 words that restate what it says. With no source from 7 slides on, a draft of at most 2 lines built from the topic’s own words (the problem named in the topic, no consequence, trend, number or organisation) and the notes open with “[Qoralama: ...]”; below 7 slides, with no source, the honest form (heading and ruled lines). Notes: the greeting “Hurmatli Davlat attestatsiya komissiyasi raisi va a’zolari!”, the topic by name, the relevance as the slide says it.

Line 1 “Maqsad: ...” in one sentence, then 3 to 5 tasks of at most 8 words in the infinitive, in the work’s own order and numbering. From the attached kirish or the message; else the aim restates the topic and the tasks restate the functions or steps the message names, marked as a draft in the notes. A work with 6 or more tasks: the last two are joined in one row with “va”, in the work’s own words (nothing is silently dropped). The notes name each task in the work’s order and say which slides answer it.

From 8 slides. Lines “Obyekt: ...”, “Predmet: ...” and, only when the customer or the file names methods, “Metodlar: ...”, of at most 12 words. Object and subject differ. With no source they are the topic’s own nouns (draft, marked in the notes); the methods line is never drafted. Spelling: obyekt, as the Latin orthography writes it.

From 8 slides. Lines “Obyekt: ...”, “Predmet: ...” and, only when the customer or the file names methods, “Metodlar: ...”, of at most 12 words. Object and subject differ. With no source they are the topic’s own nouns (draft, marked in the notes); the methods line is never drafted. Spelling: obyekt, as the Latin orthography writes it.
2 to 4 lines, each a method the customer or the file names. With none named: the honest form (heading and ruled lines); obyekt_predmet then carries no methods line.

One sentence of at most 20 words restating the work’s own novelty statement. The work states none: the honest form (heading and ruled lines). “First time”, “new” and any claim of novelty the work does not make are never written.
The totals the customer gave (2 to 4 figures). Never split by ward, never a skill or a duty the customer did not name.

One finding a slide that restates a line of the message or file; the heading names the figures as the source gives them. chart.stepped_rows: 2 to 8 bars, the labels (years, categories) written in the source (a range plus a count of values is not enough), the unit and base in columns[0]; stats.rows: 2 to 4 figures with a short label and no context line; big_number.classic: one decisive figure; bullets: findings the customer stated in words. Never written unless the customer or the file gave the content: comparison (a current-state column), process (stages), pros_cons, a survey, a sample size, a department or ward detail, a cause, a proposal. A figure with arithmetic (twice, a total, a share) is written only if the source states it. Tables are not used (no table variant meets the type floor today). A figure with arithmetic (twice, a total, a share) is written only if the source states it. Tables are not used (no table variant meets the type floor today). Notes: “Ikkinchi vazifa bo‘yicha ...” or “To‘rtinchi vazifa bo‘yicha (davomi) ...”, the slide’s numbers exactly as written, no conversion or approximation. No photo, ever.

1 to 4 lines restating the work’s own statement of significance, its use or its implementation act. No facts: the honest form (heading and ruled lines). At 10 slides it takes the place of one result slide and the result slides group the tasks.
2 to 4 numbered lines of at most 14 words copied in substance from the work’s own list; with none, the honest form (heading and ruled lines).
1 to 4 lines, one per publication or conference, exactly as the customer or the work lists them (no journal, title or date that was not given). None listed: the honest form (heading and ruled lines).
One row per task, each the answer with its figure as the source gives it (at most 12 words). Only in the 3-slide deck (cover, maqsad_vazifalar, natija_xulosa).

2 to 5 rows of at most 12 words, each taken from the work’s own conclusions or from the result slides, opening with the key words of the task it answers. A theory or proposal task gets a row only when the work’s conclusions state one; otherwise its row is left out and the slide is drawn unnumbered (bullets.classic), so a numeral never points at the wrong task. A “Taklif: ...” row only when the work states a proposal. No new fact, no number not on an earlier slide, no derived figure. Notes: the conclusions spoken, then the invitation to questions.

Line 1 “Savollaringiz bormi?” / «Вопросы?» / “Questions?” at 24 pt or more (no gendered verb), then the author line copied from the cover. No notes. From 5 slides; the 3- and 4-slide decks end on the conclusions.

rules.text: Every line of a source slide (results, novelty, significance, methods, theses, publications, placement, work done, conclusions, any “Taklif:” row) restates the customer’s message or the attached work, in its words and with its numbers. Only the framing slides (relevance, aim and tasks, object and subject) may be drafted from the topic’s own words, never methods or novelty, and their notes open with “[Qoralama: ...]” (“[Черновик: ...]”, “[Draft: ...]”). A claim, cause, trend, organisation, sample size, survey, implementation, “first time” or proposal the source does not contain is never written. A source slide with no material is an honest fill-in form: the heading “Natijalarni kiriting: <topic noun>” and rows ending in “...”.

Never a comparison, process or pros-and-cons slide, a per-department breakdown, a survey size, an implementation or a skill unless the customer or the file supplied that very content. A series’ labels (years, categories) must be written in the source; a range plus a count of values does not license the years in between. Never a table, quote, image or agenda layout; image_query is always empty.

Slide text: noun phrases and infinitive tasks of at most 10 words (12 on conclusions), 2 to 5 lines, 10 to 40 words a slide. This overrides the global guide of about 111 words a slide; the same variant may repeat.

The thread: aim, tasks, results and conclusions answer one another. Each task is answered by result slides (data) or by the work’s own text (theory, proposal). Result slides follow the order of the data tasks, one finding each, and their notes name the task (“Ikkinchi vazifa bo‘yicha ...”). A conclusion row restates the work’s conclusion or a result slide and opens with its task’s key words; numbered rows only when rows equal tasks.

Numbers only from the message or the work, with unit and period, never rounded, converted or computed; in the notes as digits exactly as on the slide; never “taxminan”, “about” or “примерно” on a number. A figure that cannot be read with certainty is left out; when the message and the file disagree, the message wins.

Notes: 30 to 90 words a body slide, as long as the slide’s facts allow and never padded. Slide 2 opens with “Hurmatli Davlat attestatsiya komissiyasi raisi va a’zolari!” and the topic by name. Russian notes avoid gendered first-person past forms. The cover and the closing slide carry no notes.

Cover: the topic in full, then only the customer’s or the file’s lines, copied as written, in the order work type, institution, author, supervisor, speciality, place and year; never a ministry line the customer did not write, never a year of your own. The closing slide repeats the author line.

Layout by the supplied content: a series over time or a ranking, chart; 2 to 4 key figures, stats; one decisive figure, big_number; findings in words, bullets; one series a slide. A result heading is a finding with its figure (at most 12 words), never a bare label.

Language follows the customer’s. Uzbek is Latin only (o‘ g‘ with ‘, the tutuq belgisi with ’: ta’lim; but obyekt). Russian decks use Выполнил(а) and Научный руководитель, English Prepared by and Supervisor; no emoji, no exclamation mark except in the thanks heading.
Never invent a person, degree, institution, programme, order, act, grade, publication, conference, patent, law, quotation, source or company. There is no references slide and never a quiz slide.

look.note: The research type contract (list text from 24 pt, one slide counter, no cover disc) changes the deck renderer and is not in this round; the pins keep the calm variants.

gates: A native Uzbek reader checks the fixed headings (Mavzuning dolzarbligi, Obyekt, predmet va metodlar, Obyekt va predmet, Himoyaga olib chiqilayotgan asosiy qoidalar).
A 6, a 10 and a 15 slide sample in uz, ru and en are drawn with the deck sample tool, with and without figures in the message, and looked at next to units/slides.himoya/mock/school_himoya.png.
A native Russian reader checks the fixed headings and the bot copy in Russian.
One real-provider run, scripts/operations/ai_smoke.py --category slides.himoya on the server, makes the deck with every check passing, and the deck is looked at, before the tick.

later.text: New variants bullets.aim_tasks and chart.pairs and the new layout kind figure.
The review-screen claim check with a remove button per slide.
Fewer slides than asked when the material is thin: the count is delivered as quoted.
A cover title of up to 25 words: the deck renderer draws 14 words and stores 160 characters.

Research launch gate, not adopted as a gate: 1. Type floor and one heading position (the contract of looks.launch_contract): list ceiling 28 pt and floor 24; item text 22 pt start and 18 pt floor (20 for bold); headline 32 pt in the one box; one slide counter; no cover disc; closing slide 32/24 pt. Without it the deck is what mock/school_himoya-today.png shows.
Research launch gate, not adopted as a gate: 2. Per-template variant allow-list (pins): looks.variants must reach the renderer. “No pins, no release.” Plumbing, not new drawing.

Research launch gate, not adopted as a gate: 3. Cover: heading cap 14 words / 160 characters to 25 words / 260 characters with the 48 to 26 pt scale, the defence cover (institution on top, author rows, no disc), the dropped-line order and the notice. The validator’s 160-character cut on title and heading must be lifted too (measured: a 245-character topic lost its tail at 160).

Research launch gate, not adopted as a gate: 4. Server: count named = ceiling (fewer slides when the material is thin, with the notice), clamp 30 and 3, type-aware default (6, 10, 15, 8), minutes + 2; no extra bot step.

Research launch gate, not adopted as a gate: 5. Review-screen claim check (section 6 of the design document): numbers, content words and forbidden slots, listed per slide with a remove button; the prototype is work/claims.py.
